description: This file defines the 'Add' feature for favoriting articles in a C# ASP.NET Core project, including request validation, handling logic, and interactions with the database context.

classes.name: Add.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validates that the Slug property in the command is not null or empty.

classes.name: Add.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the logic for adding an article to the current user's favorites, including validation, database access, and error handling.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes the command to favorite an article, retrieves data, performs checks, adds the favorite if not present, and returns the article envelope.
